description: Use for 'which companies am I tracking?' or 'is acme.com on my list?'. Lists the accounts (companies) on the connected workspace's list, or matches domains you pass against it, with each account's last recorded check date, the domains not on the list and pagination. Saved records only: adds nothing and runs no new check.

domains.description: Optional company domains to check against your tracked list, up to 200. Omit to use your tracked accounts.

offset.description: Start at this offset, default 0. Follow next_offset for remaining accounts.

name: list_accounts

missing_domains.description: Requested domains that are not on the list.

next_offset.description: Pass as offset for the next page; null on the last page.

title: List tracked accounts
